7.1 Partial Network Cluster Management
The ComM offers users the option to wake and keep awake so-called "partial network
cluster" (PNC). A PNC is a (logical) group of ECUs which have to be active at the same
time to realize some distributed functionality. If PNC-enabled gateways are used, a
PNC can span the whole network (different busses on different topology levels of the
network hierarchy). Without the PN functionality, NM messages can only wake and
keep awake whole busses.
